title: Bitcoin's Required Return: paper and replication package
description: Working paper and full replication package. Survival analysis of 1,815 cryptoassets with 520 curated deaths (mortality curves, Lindy test, elite jump hazard); Bitcoin's required return bounded via Merton's (1987) limited-participation condition with measured inputs (surveyed holder portfolio weights, option-implied bounds); required-plus-wedge decomposition of realized returns; committed 2026-2031 forecast. Includes all scripts, curated data tables, figures, and an audit script that re-checks every number quoted in the paper.
